items.title: The Middleton Family at the New York World's Fair (made by Audio Productions Inc. for Westinghouse, 1939, Technicolor, 54 minutes 44 seconds; Prelinger Archives rendition, 640x480): a corporate drama in which a family spends a day among the fair's exhibits
items.license: Public Domain, as the source page states it (rights: "Public Domain."; Prelinger Archives, Internet Archive). A Westinghouse-sponsored corporate film, not a government work; its soundtrack is the film's own. The project uses the film as the source page publishes it, relying on its public-domain statement.
